findings.recommendation: Reconcile the specific entries; do not merge constructor IDs globally.

findings.classification: Conflicting entry metadata; exact truth not established
findings.recommendation: Keep both values and an audit flag until a documented authority is chosen.
Flag disputed slots; do not substitute qualifying order without accounting for penalties.

findings.classification: Strong evidence of swapped fields in seven Monaco 2024 records
findings.recommendation: Swap stop/lap for the identified records on a cleaned copy and verify chronology and keys.
Flag incomplete history; do not invent a missing stop or renumber the observed record.

findings.classification: Official classification and timing log disagree; not necessarily corruption
findings.recommendation: Retain both fields; distinguish recorded laps from classified laps.

findings.classification: Fastest-lap metadata contradicts classified lap total
findings.recommendation: Flag the bundle; examine lap logs before choosing a source or setting values missing.

findings.classification: Timing versus classification discrepancy for a disqualified entry
findings.recommendation: Preserve observed pit stops; do not overwrite official zero-lap classification automatically.

findings.classification: Different classification/order conventions in one historical race
findings.recommendation: Document the discrepancy; preserve the milestone target definition positionOrder <= 3.

findings.classification: Withdrawal can occur after a race start in historical records
findings.recommendation: Do not define every Withdrew label as a non-start across all eras.

findings.classification: Historical withdrawal markers do not universally imply DNS
findings.recommendation: Condition start inference on era and lap evidence; retain unresolved cases.

findings.classification: Withdrawal marker carries information missing from the status-only start rule
findings.recommendation: Use both positionText and failure status when forming the Q3 numerator and denominator.

findings.classification: Numeric no-ranking marker, not an actual fastest-lap rank
findings.recommendation: Represent unranked as missing in a derived rank column; preserve raw zero.

findings.classification: Valid constructor ID, but no corresponding race/team entry in results
findings.recommendation: Reconcile by race; beware duplicate aggregates after mapping a conflicting team ID.

findings.classification: Status and classified lap totals disagree
findings.recommendation: Flag, distinguish timing/classification conventions, and avoid guessed replacement values.

scope: Supplied CSVs only. Flags are evidence for review, not automatic corrections.
